_comment: Recomputed whenever mark.svg changes. Carrying old numbers over is how a
clipped icon ships: every fraction here is derived from the ink box, and the
ink box changes the moment the drawing does.
The binding constraint is the envelope's bottom corners - the top corners
carry no ink, because the record is a centred circle.
pending: Exact stroke weight as a fraction of the ink box, from Cinemail
Exact envelope geometry from Cinemail: flap apex, edge angle, front panel
ratio, whether the back wall shows on both sides. Drawn by eye until then,
which is the difference between siblings and cousins.
